description: Read a proof by qHash or search proofs by scope, tags, verifier, or text. With no filter, returns an index hint; scope=all pages metadata. Use include=content for proof bodies and includeComments with qHash for discussion. Omit identifier when signed in.

agentWallet.description: Optional agent wallet for reading proofs under granted permissions.

identifier.description: Wallet address (EVM 0x... or Solana base58) or DID (did:pkh:...)

include.description: Default metadata. content requires a known qHash or narrowing filter; scope=all does not unlock bodies. Filtered content pages are capped at source.

includeComments.description: Include comments for one known proof. Requires qHash; comment visibility follows proof access.

qHash.description: Optional proof id. When set, returns that one record instead of a vault page.

scope.description: Optional preset when tags omitted: memory | research | rules | instruction | tools | jobs | receipts. Use scope=all to list every proof newest first, and tags for arbitrary tags. Pair a scope with include=content to read a whole page of bodies in one call.

tagContains.description: Return proofs with a tag containing this text.

tagPrefix.description: Return proofs with a tag that starts with this prefix.

tagPrefixesAll.description: Require every comma-separated prefix to match the start of a tag.

tags.description: Comma-separated exact tag values. Takes precedence over scope; use values from the proof index.

verifierId.description: Optional check ID filter. Use it to request only proofs from one check.

name: proofable_proofs_get
